summary: A successful kick against a trapped closed or locked door reaches an unsupported D_TRAPPED branch in dokick.c:kick_door. C announces the kick, exercises Strength negatively, clears the door to D_NODOOR, calls b_trapped("door", FOOT), then refreshes the tile and vision. The JavaScript branch throws before those effects. The complete function port must also replace its existing shop and town refusal sites with source-backed implementations or explicit unported-call records.

source.branch: The target is a D_TRAPPED door that is closed or locked; the hero is not levitating; and the attempt succeeds through the doorbuster check or rnl(35) being below avrg_attrib plus martial Dexterity.
callers: dokick.c:dokick (1465-1469): after monster, pool, object, and nondoor handling, IS_DOOR targets call kick_door(x, y, avrg_attrib).
dependencies: trap.c:b_trapped is already implemented in js/trap.js; kick_door ignores its C return value.

Whole-function follow-up sites in dokick.c:kick_door: shop-door add_damage/pay_for_damage and town get_iter_mons/get_iter_mons_xy callbacks are still unsupported in JavaScript; their C return values are discarded.

evidence: Replayed only this recording using the exact evaluated root snapshot 9aea0fdd726850fad5342bc3eabb32f89a78a0c0 and its nethack-c/upstream gitlink 16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4. scanSyntheticSession reported screensEmitted=33 of recordedSteps=40, then refused the next h input with “kick_door()'s D_TRAPPED caller branch”; the saved queue places that stop at zero-based step 33 with 7 screens remaining. The replay reported no earlier screen, cursor, or RNG divergence.

nethack-c/upstream/src/dokick.c:kick_door, lines 934-939: after the doorbuster/rnl success check, D_TRAPPED prints “You kick the door.” when verbose, calls exercise(A_STR, FALSE), sets gm.maploc->doormask = D_NODOOR, then calls b_trapped("door", FOOT). The shared successful-door tail calls feel_newsym and recalc_block_point before shop and town follow-ups.

nethack-c/upstream/src/dokick.c:dokick, lines 1465-1469, is the source caller. At the evaluated commit, js/dokick.js:kick_door lines 658-664 throws UnsupportedKickError at D_TRAPPED before the source effects; js/trap.js:b_trapped already implements the explosion path. Other unsupported branches remain inside kick_door at the shop/town follow-ups and are included when scoping its whole-function port.
